title: Last Stone Weight II
goal: Minimize the final stone weight after repeatedly smashing pairs.
strategy: Every outcome corresponds to splitting weights into two signed groups. Find the largest achievable subset sum at most half the total; the remaining imbalance is total minus twice that sum.
